university.name: Greenfield University
university.description: A mid-sized off-grid university campus with 8 load points, powered by a 500 kW solar PV array, a 150 kW diesel generator, and a 1,200 kWh battery bank.

diesel_generator.note: Dispatched when solar + battery cannot meet priority load deficit threshold

controller_rules.name: Solar-first dispatch
controller_rules.description: Solar PV output is used first to serve active loads and charge the battery. Surplus solar charges the battery at up to 200 kW when SOC < 90% (1,080 kWh).

controller_rules.name: Priority dispatch order (day)
controller_rules.description: During daytime (07:00–17:59): LP1 > LP2 > LP3 > LP4 > LP5 > LP6 > LP7. LP8 is inactive in daylight.

controller_rules.name: Priority dispatch order (night)
controller_rules.description: During night (18:00–06:59): LP1 > LP8 > LP4 > LP2 > LP3 > LP5 > LP6 > LP7. LP8 elevated for campus safety.

controller_rules.name: Load shedding threshold
controller_rules.description: LP2–LP7 are served only if at least 50% of their current demand can be met from available power. LP1 and LP8 have a 0% threshold.

controller_rules.name: Battery discharge rule
controller_rules.description: The controller discharges the battery only when SOC exceeds 50% (600 kWh). Below this level, the battery is held in reserve and not discharged, even if loads are unsupplied. This conservative threshold is a known limitation of the rule-based approach.

controller_rules.name: Battery charge rule
controller_rules.description: Battery charges on any solar surplus above total eligible load demand, up to 200 kW charge rate.

controller_rules.name: Diesel start condition
controller_rules.description: The diesel generator starts only when the shortfall in priority load supply (LP1–LP4) exceeds 30% of total priority demand. This reactive threshold means the generator is started after load shedding has already begun, rather than pre-emptively.

controller_rules.name: Diesel output sizing
controller_rules.description: When started, diesel is dispatched at the maximum of the calculated shortfall and 40% minimum load (60 kW), up to 150 kW rated capacity.

controller_rules.name: Diesel fuel cost accounting
controller_rules.description: Fuel consumption follows a linear derating model: L = 10 + 30 × (P / 150) litres/hr. Fuel price (NGN/litre) varies hourly with seasonal trends and periodic supply shocks.

controller_rules.name: Emergency load shedding
controller_rules.description: When battery SOC is at or below the 50% discharge threshold and solar output cannot cover priority loads, LP7 (Sports Complex) is the first load shed. No further automated shedding logic is applied beyond the priority dispatch order.

performance_metrics.note: These metrics represent the baseline rule-based controller performance against which the DQN agent will be benchmarked.

files.source_availability.csv: 8,760 rows × 26 columns. Core: timestamp, hour, hour_of_day, day_of_year, month, is_weekday. Solar: solar_pv_availability_fraction, solar_pv_output_kw. Diesel: diesel_available, diesel_dispatched_kw, diesel_on, diesel_fuel_consumed_litres, diesel_fuel_price_NGN_per_litre, diesel_cost_NGN. Battery: battery_soc_kwh, battery_charge_kw, battery_discharge_kw. Totals: total_generation_kw, total_available_kw. Solar forecasts (realistic noise): solar_forecast_t1h_kw, solar_forecast_t3h_kw, solar_forecast_t6h_kw. Demand forecasts (realistic noise): demand_forecast_t1h_kw, demand_forecast_t3h_kw, demand_forecast_t6h_kw. Fuel tracking: cumulative_daily_fuel_litres.
files.load_demand_and_dispatch.csv: 8,760 rows × 28 columns. For each LP (LP1–LP8): _powered (0/1), _demand_kw (unconstrained demand), _effective_kw (actual power served).
files.university_metadata.json: University profile, load point specs, source specs, controller rules, and baseline performance metrics.

solar_forecast.noise_model: Multiplicative Gaussian noise on true future values
solar_forecast.real_world_equivalent: Open-Meteo / Solcast NWP solar irradiance API

demand_forecast.noise_model: Multiplicative Gaussian noise on true future demand
demand_forecast.real_world_equivalent: Historical schedule-based demand model (hour-of-day x day-of-week lookup)

forecast_methodology.note: Forecast errors are calibrated to published benchmarks for short-term solar irradiance and university building load forecasting. Errors grow with horizon, reflecting real forecast degradation. These forecasts are part of the DQN state space, enabling forward-looking dispatch decisions not available to the rule-based controller baseline.
